headline: Collin County Home Backup Report
summary: Homes in Collin County face an elevated risk of long power outages. Records from 2018 show a long outage about once every 9 years. In February 2021, 34% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 73 hours. In May 2024, 23% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth waited about 51 hours. One Core lasts about 16 hours in January. One Core lasts about 35 hours in November. Two Cores last about 32 hours in January. Two Cores cover 90% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
